title: VAT and e-invoicing
description: For a change to checkout, billing or invoices: the VAT treatment per country and customer type, the content of invoices and the French e-invoicing calendar.

sources.title: Council Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax
impots.gouv.fr, Je passe à la facturation électronique
Service-Public Entreprendre, La facturation électronique est effective depuis le 1er septembre 2026

rules.instruction: Record in the billing configuration the VAT treatment for each country sold to and each customer type, business or consumer, as confirmed by the tax adviser.
rules.verification: Read the tax configuration export and check that each country and customer type sold to has a rule and the name of who confirmed it.

rules.instruction: Validate a business customer's VAT number, for example with the European Commission VIES service, before invoicing it without VAT, and keep the validation date.
rules.verification: In the customer records, check that every business customer invoiced without VAT has a VAT number and a validation date.

rules.instruction: Generate invoices with the mandatory particulars that apply in the seller's country, including a sequential number, the VAT numbers, the rate and the VAT amount or the reason for exemption.
rules.verification: Compare a test invoice for each customer type with the list of mandatory particulars kept by finance.

rules.instruction: For a company established in France, receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026 and issue them from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-sized companies, or 1 September 2027 for SMEs and micro-enterprises, through the platform finance chose.
rules.verification: Check that the task record names the e-invoicing platform and links a test invoice received, and sent when the company's date has passed.
